Rooms.Name: Mountain Trail
Rooms.Description:
This trail leads high into the mountains. You hope you don't fall because
it would result in instant death. The trail continues to the east. To the south
a half cleared trail leads downward. To the west you can see a large plateau.

Rooms.Name: Mountain Trail
Rooms.Description:
You're really high up now. You can keep going even farther up into the
mountains to the east, or go back down to the west.

Rooms.Name: Mountain Trail
Rooms.Description:
Wispy clouds are beginning to surround you now, and your ears pop due to the
altitude. To the east, you see the summit of the mountain, and from the way the
nearby mountains are arranged behind it, you believe you're on your way to a
big valley. You can also go down to the west.

Rooms.Name: Near the Mountain's Peak
Rooms.Description:
The peak of this mountain is another couple hundred feet above you, but here
is where the trail leads down into the valley... What an odd valley! The valley
seems to have been filled up by a hundreds of feet of lava many years ago. It
gives the valley an odd, 'flat' look and darkish ground. The path leads down
east into the valley, and west back to civilization.

Rooms.Name: Trail to the Valley
Rooms.Description:
The trail leads down into the valley, where, by judging by the height of the
trees, the lava had cooled tens of decades ago. Down below you see the path
lead into the small forest in the valley, and disappear out of sight. East
leads into the valley, West back to civilization.

Rooms.Name: In the Valley
Rooms.Description:
The ground has taken on the texture of dirt on the top, but this valley is
far too flat and too rocky to disguise the catastrophe that happened here so
long ago. Looking up to the mountains ringing this area, you notice several
mountains look as if they had 'exploded', which is strange, considering that
they are not volcanoes. The path leads into the woods to the east, and back up
the mountain to the west.

Rooms.Name: In a Clearing
Rooms.Description:
You come to a small clearing now, after walking for several minutes through
the silent woods. An odd block sticks up here and there in the ground... ...
wait a minute. These stones seem a little too regular, and from the circle
formation and size you could almost swear that they were... crenellations?
Could some sort of building been buried by the lava here? A rusty ring sticks
out of the earth in the center... a trapdoor? This is almost too good to be
true!

Exits.Description: An ancient trapdoor, grimed with earth and age.

Rooms.Name: A Stairwell
Rooms.Description:
This small room is the top of a stairwell leading down deep into the tower.
A small trapdoor overhead leaks the light of day around its edges. To the south
is a wooden door, preserved through the ages by means unknown. To the west is a
short hall.

Exits.Description: An ancient trapdoor, grimed with earth and age.

Rooms.Name: A Linen Closet
Rooms.Description:
This small room holds many types of linen on shelves along the walls. They
are undoubtedly preserved by magic against the toil of the ages, since they
seem freshly washed and folded. You wonder what sort of mage could wield so
much power to waste on such little things.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
White sheets, pillow-cases, etc.  Not really  anything that you need, but
interesting.

Rooms.Name: Corridor
Rooms.Description:
This is only a clean corridor, that leads back to the stairwell to the east,
and has doors leading to other rooms to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: Bathroom
Rooms.Description:
This is some sort of bathroom, like you've never seen before... Water
appliances leading from nowhere deliver hot and cold running water to basins
that drain to... where? How strange!

Rooms.Name: Master Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
This is an opulent room, decorated in silks and gold. There is an ebony desk
against one wall, cooled lava rock spilling over its surface from the window it
once looked out at. A nice, spacious closet is filled with clothes just cleaned
and pressed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Nice clothes, but not your size at all.
The desk is basically uninteresting, as are the papers on top of it...

Rooms.Name: The Library
Rooms.Description:
A great mages' library is contained on this floor of the tower. You feel you
could learn anything you wanted to if you only looked and read long enough. A
strange chessgame is standing on a oak table in the middle of the room. It 
looks very old, dust have collected all around it, but not on it. To the
east a door leads back to the stairwell.

Exits.Description: A big bookcase, that looks rather odd.
If you go down you enter the magic chessboard.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you examine the chessgame more closely you can see that the small pieces are
moving around. As they played by them self. On a box beside the chessboard
you can read the following words..
"Chessgame of Illusions this is the trap of the two mages Malthus and Turing
 they could never beat each other in chess so they agreed to be transformed
 into a illusionary chessgame. One condition from the maker was that they
 couldn't leave the game before either off them had won. As they never could
 beat each other they where trapped forever."

Created by Coke for Elite mud. To enter go down.
There's lots of books about everything here!

Rooms.Name: Stairwell
Rooms.Description: This stairwell continues up and down, and there is a door to the west.

Rooms.Name: A Hidden Hall
Rooms.Description:
This is a small hidden hall with a secret entrance to the library on the
north end of the west wall, and a trapdoor on the south end.

Exits.Description: The backside of a movable bookcase.

Rooms.Name: A Stairwell
Rooms.Description:
This stairwell continues up and down, and there is a door to the west
opening up onto this level.

Rooms.Name: Hidden Treasure Room
Rooms.Description: Jackpot! A small room filled with treasure chests! Go get it!

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
This hall runs through the tower. There's more hall to the west, and doors
to your north and south. A door to the east leads back to the stairwell.

Rooms.Name: Servant's Room
Rooms.Description:
This seems to be a small servant's bedroom, sparsely decorated and outfitted
with a bed, night stand, chair and table, etc. Nothing real important here.

Rooms.Name: Servant's Room
Rooms.Description:
This seems to be a small servant's bedroom, sparsely decorated and outfitted
with a bed, night stand, chair and table, etc. Nothing real important here.

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
This hallway continues to the east, and has a door to the north. You could
swear that the way this level is arranged... nah, couldn't be.

Rooms.Name: Servant's Room
Rooms.Description:
This seems to be a small servant's bedroom, sparsely decorated and outfitted
with a bed, night stand, chair and a table, etc. Nothing real important here.

Rooms.Name: Stairwell
Rooms.Description: This stairwell leads up and down, and there is a big open room to your west.

Rooms.Name: Dining Hall
Rooms.Description:
This is a large dining hall, with a long table that runs down the length of
it. Chairs are set up along the sides to accommodate approximately 10 people.
There are paintings and tapestries on the walls, adding color to the stonework.
The cooled lava that had poured in the windows makes the place seem eerie
somehow . There is a door to the north, and the stairwell is to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Many of these show scenes of high magic and heroism. Just like almost every
tapestry and painting you've seen.

Rooms.Name: Kitchen Area
Rooms.Description:
This is a well-stocked kitchen, the larders still fresh and full as if by
magic. Perhaps this would be a good place to take a break.

Rooms.Name: Stairwell
Rooms.Description:
The stairwell leads up and down here, and there is a hall you can enter to
the west.

Rooms.Name: Hall
Rooms.Description:
This area of the tower seems dank and oppressive. The hall runs north-south
and there is an empty cell to your west. The stairwell is to your east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's open, empty, and uninteresting.

Rooms.Name: Hall
Rooms.Description:
This is the northern end of the hall. There are cells to your right and
left, empty and awaiting occupants.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's open, empty, and uninteresting.

Rooms.Name: Hall
Rooms.Description:
This is the southern end of the hall. There are cells to your right and
left, empty and awaiting occupants.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's open, empty, and uninteresting.

Rooms.Name: Stairwell
Rooms.Description: The stairwell continues up and down here. A large room opens up to the west.

Rooms.Name: Mage's Office
Rooms.Description:
A small desk here is cluttered with magically preserved papers and
documents. None seem of value, except perhaps to a historian. This place seems
vaguely uninteresting...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's cluttered with all sorts of papers.  Some look half interesting,
actually.

Well, one of the papers relate a story about how the mage of this tower,
Rand, angered many kings, and relates how they set his armies on him. You
wonder if the lava outside was a failed attempt to destroy the armies...

Rooms.Name: Stairwell
Rooms.Description: The stairs go up and down here, and there is a room to the west...

Rooms.Name: Sitting Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a simply furnished room, with chairs all about. A fireplace is inset
into an inner wall, the chimney undoubtedly directed by magic... This would be
a nice place to rest awhile...

Rooms.Name: Stairwell
Rooms.Description: This is where the stairwell finally ends. There is a hall to your west.

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
This small hallway on the former 'ground floor' ran north-south. To the east
is the stairwell that leads up into the shadowy recesses of the tower. To the
west is the entrance way to the tower. The north is completely blocked off by
lava, and the way south is still clear.

Rooms.Name: Entranceway
Rooms.Description:
This is a grand chamber with giant double-doors to the west. To the east is
the main floor of the tower. This room is arranged highly attractively and very
impressively, with sculptures and tapestries everywhere. The doors seem
impenetrable... you don't think you'd be able to get through them if you really
had to...

Exits.Description: These doors seem incredible. Unfortunately, they're locked.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They look nice, but aren't very valuable.

Rooms.Name: Doorway
Rooms.Description:
This was the entrance to the tower. Now lava has blocked it up completely.
However: It seems when the lava came down a man was outside the doors. He was
blasted into the doors, and died instantly, but his skeleton still clutches a
staff in perfect condition...

Exits.Description: These double doors have the outline of a man blasted into them...

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
This is the southern part of the hallway. There is a door to the west,
barred with gleaming bands of lights. To the north is more hallway.

Rooms.Name: Stairs
Rooms.Description:
Stairs lead down here into the tower's basement, or you can head east into
the main floor of the tower.

Rooms.Name: Stairs
Rooms.Description:
Stairs lead up here to the main level, or you can go east to the basement of
the tower.

Rooms.Name: Alcove
Rooms.Description:
This alcove leads into a huge room to your north, and to stairs leading down
to the east, and stairs going up to your west.

Rooms.Name: Laboratory
Rooms.Description:
This laboratory has lots of stuff in it. Beakers, flasks, burners, tongs,
mortars and pestles, jars filled with normal things, jars filled with abnormal
things, jars filled with things you'd rather not think about... A search could
reveal many things...

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Looks like normal, fragile lab equipment to you.

Rooms.Name: Stairs
Rooms.Description:
Stairs lead down here to the second level of the basement, or back west to
the alcove.

Rooms.Name: Stairs
Rooms.Description:
Stairs lead up here to the first level of the basement, or you can go east
to another big room.

Rooms.Name: Summoning Room
Rooms.Description:
This room is darkly lit by a giant glowing pentagram in the center of the
room. Bands of force encircle some sort of being trapped inside. You think that
going inside would be an EXTREMELY BAD idea...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can't see it clearly through the energy field of the pentagram, but you
sense that whatever it is, it is very, very, very, very angry.
It's centuries old.  You don't think standing close by would be a good idea.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Pentagram
Rooms.Description:
The small god entrapped by the wizard looks at you with an insane
expression. Four hundred years of imprisonment doesn't do much for ones...
OOPS! He killed you! You are dead, R. I. P.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail going up the mountain. Further ahead the trail
makes a turn around a large cliff. If you walk north you will go around this
rock and if you walk south you will go down the mountain to its base.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You have almost reached the top of the mountain. To the south you see the
forest of Namir. If you look very closely to the south-west you can see the
city of Midgaard. The trail continues up to the north and down to the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a old trail up the mountain. Large rocks and cliffs
surround you on both sides. The trail continues up to the north and down to
the south.

Rooms.Name: Old Trail up the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on a half cleared mountain trail. You are walking between high 
cliffs and large rocks. The trail makes its way upward to the north and to the
south it goes down to the base of the mountain.

Rooms.Name: The Start of the Old Trail up the Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the base of the Moria mountains. A half cleared trail
leads up the mountains to the north. To the south a trail leads back to
Midgaard. Far to the west you can see the river flowing into the mountain and
to the east you see the large forest of Namir. A large sign have been placed
on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads
North, Old Trail to the Dwarven mines.
South, Trail to the city of Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: The Plateau
Rooms.Description:
A huge rockfall has blocked the narrow pass that once led north 
through the Moria mountains. The plateau continues further to the east,
and to the south, a narrow path passes precariously close to the cliff 
edge.

Mobs.Name: goat mountain
Mobs.LongDescription: A mountain goat nibbles at a piece of grass here.
Mobs.Description:
This goat is acclimated to the rugged terrain of the mountains.  It looks at
you and shies away a little.

Mobs.Name: demon decay
Mobs.LongDescription: A cloaked and clawed demon of decay comes at you viciously!
Mobs.Description:
This demon has pure malevolence for anything living.  Oops!  You're living!
I guess that means you!

Mobs.Name: book monster guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: A mound of books rise up into a human shape and tries to hit you!
Mobs.Description: Ironically enough, the book-monster's head is War and Peace.  Hmm.

Mobs.Name: bad feeling
Mobs.LongDescription: A bad feeling chokes your throat.
Mobs.Description:
It resembles a lot of other bad feelings you've had, but a lot more
tangible....magic?

Mobs.Name: nightmare
Mobs.LongDescription: Your worst nightmare coalesces in front of you and attacks!
Mobs.Description:
It looks like you deepest, darkest fears personified.  Wait a minute!  It IS
your deepest, darkest fears personified!

Mobs.Name: guardian
Mobs.LongDescription: A guardian guards the door.  It looks at you and attacks!
Mobs.Description: The guardian guards the door.  That's about all its brain can handle: guarding.

Objects.Name: dagger glowing
Objects.Description: A glowing dagger glows here.

Objects.Name: glowing platemail plate mail
Objects.Description: Some glowing platemail lies in a heap here.

Objects.Name: agate gem
Objects.Description: A small gem lies here.

Objects.Name: jade jewel
Objects.Description: A small jewel gleams here.

Objects.Name: sculpture
Objects.Description: A nice piece of sculpture is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Its of a beautiful woman, straining
beneath a heavy weight.  She looks
tired, with chiseled tears staining
her cheeks.  It makes you sad.

Objects.Name: vial dragons blood
Objects.Description: A small vial filled with a red fluid lies in the dust here.

Objects.Name: amulet
Objects.Description: An odd looking amulet has been discarded here.

Objects.Name: tent pole
Objects.Description: A tent pole has been tossed away here.

Objects.Name: bag powder wealth
Objects.ShortDescription: a bag of powder of wealth
Objects.Description: A small bag filled with powder of wealth lies here.

Objects.Name: desk
Objects.Description: There is an ebony desk here.

Objects.Name: chaos book
Objects.Description: A book with a title written in moving letters rests here.

Objects.Name: elder book
Objects.Description: A grey-bound book lies here.

Objects.Name: mevais herb leaf
Objects.Description: A small black leaf of a mevais plant lies here, well preserved.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Quaffing this down might provide interesting effects.

Objects.Name: bottle peska
Objects.Description: There is a bottle of a milky fluid here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a milky concoction, with strange motes floating in it.

Objects.Name: rand staff
Objects.Description: There is a metal-shod staff here.

Objects.Name: chest wooden
Objects.Description: There is a wooden chest here.

Objects.Name: chest wooden
Objects.Description: There is a wooden chest here.

Objects.Name: chest wooden
Objects.Description: There is a wooden chest here.

Objects.Name: basin water
Objects.Description: A basin filled with crisp, clean water is here.

Objects.Name: food
Objects.Description: There's some food lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's just random and assorted food.
   Don't ask questions.  It's just a game.
